input: Find churches holding Vacation Bible School (VBS) in 2025 or 2026 (search "VBS 2026", "VBS 2025" and "vacation bible school" with each town name; small and rural churches too) for kids and teens in Burnsville, Spruce Pine and Bakersville, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: West Burnsville Baptist Church
candidates.note: Evening VBS June 1–6, 2025, and June 7–12, 2026, with dinner.

candidates.name: Shoal Creek Baptist Church of Burnsville
Browns Creek Baptist Church of Burnsville
candidates.note: VBS in June 2025 and Emerald Crossing VBS June 14–19, 2026, with dinner.

candidates.name: Elk Shoal Baptist Church of Burnsville
candidates.note: Held Wonder Junction & Calvary Corral evening VBS in July 2025.

candidates.name: Faith Fellowship Church of Newdale (Burnsville)
candidates.note: Held Emerald Crossing VBS in June 2026 at 35 Partner Lane.

candidates.name: Higgins Methodist Church of Burnsville
candidates.note: Held Junkyard Redemption evening VBS July 13–17, 2026.

candidates.name: Big Crabtree Baptist Church of Spruce Pine
candidates.note: Wonder Junction VBS in July 2025; Illumination Station July 12–17, 2026.

candidates.name: Grassy Creek Baptist Church of Spruce Pine
candidates.note: The Search for Jesus VBS June 22–26, 2026; classes from tots through young adults.

candidates.name: Western Carolina Church of Spruce Pine
candidates.note: Kingdom Quest VBS July 26–29, 2026, 6–8 p.m.; preschool through rising sixth grade.

candidates.name: First Presbyterian Church of Spruce Pine
candidates.note: Hosted joint VBS July 22–24, 2025, for preschool–fifth grade; also co-ran 2026 VBS.

candidates.name: Central Baptist Church of Spruce Pine
candidates.note: Co-ran joint community VBS with three other Spruce Pine churches in 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: Spruce Pine United Methodist Church
candidates.note: Co-ran 2025 community VBS and hosted God's Creation from Genesis VBS July 21–23, 2026.

candidates.name: Trinity Episcopal Church of Spruce Pine
candidates.note: Co-ran joint community VBS with three other Spruce Pine churches in 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: Snow Hill Baptist Church of Bakersville
candidates.note: Listed VBS with dates TBA alongside its 2026 summer events; occurrence not confirmed.
